shared_presentation.correlation: PendingRequestView stores only a pending UI request identity and its submitted local view epoch. begin rejects empty identities and second pending registration without replacing the first. poll returns NoResult/CurrentView/EarlierView; successful matching delivery releases the UI slot and preserves the exact outcome. Missing, non-string, mismatched, unsolicited or duplicate request IDs refuse before local correlation/output mutation. False/throwing callback leaves local correlation/output unchanged; this does not roll back a callback or recover a consumed response.
shared_presentation.view_policy: Compare exact local epochs for equality, including u64 maximum; do not rebase an old request onto a newer view. GUI/TUI retain earlier outcomes separately and keep current interaction/navigation local. Local view epochs are not worker/capture epochs, source authenticity or durable operation IDs.
shared_presentation.availability: view_command_available is GUI/TUI command-view eligibility based on the compiled composition discovery. Only an exact unique string ID with string availability=available is eligible; protocol.serve/shell.open/shell.close and empty IDs are excluded. Missing/mistyped discovery or matching duplicate records fail closed. Unknown observational background is ignored. Parameter form support, provider admission and operator grants remain separately checked.
shared_presentation.behaviour_changes: Normal valid inputs, command IDs, schemas and GUI/TUI navigation remain unchanged. Malformed/duplicate private discovery now deterministically fails closed rather than dereferencing missing data or choosing a duplicate. Non-string request identity cannot match a string even if its native text field is equal.
